Ordinary Council Meeting - 22 July 2026

Wednesday, July 22, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending an Ordinary Council Meeting

Members of the public who wish to ask questions or address the Council will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are presented by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations are delivered. Please note that meetings will commence at 5:00pm unless stated otherwise. 

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and public address requests before 12noon the day prior via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

Livestream Links below. 

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream. 

Livestream Link: https://youtube.com/live/WENbR37hreA?feature=share

For further information or assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Minutes

Public Minutes - Ordinary Council Meeting - 22 July 2026 (6.77 MB)

Agenda

Public Agenda - Ordinary Council Meeting - 22 July 2026 (6.67 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Contact Us

Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 27 May 2026

Wednesday, May 27, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending an Ordinary Council Meeting

Members of the public who wish to ask questions or address the Council will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are presented by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations are delivered. Please note that meetings will commence at 5:00pm unless stated otherwise. 

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and public address requests before 12noon the day prior via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

Livestream Links below. 

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Livestream Link: https://youtube.com/live/YoW8nSEkSsw?feature=share 

For further information or assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

This Agenda was amended on 26 May 2026 at 4.31pm withdrawing Item 15.1.

Public Minutes - Ordinary Council Meeting - 27 May 2026 (9.05 MB)

Public Agenda - Ordinary Council Meeting - 27 May 2026 (8.98 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 25 March 2026

Wednesday, March 25, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 5pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests before 12noon the day prior via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Livestream Link: 

We are currently experiencing some technical difficulties with our live stream. The Ordinary Council Meeting will be recorded and uploaded post closure of meeting. 

Minutes

Public Minutes - Ordinary Council Meeting - 25 March 2026 (6.02 MB)

Agenda

Public Agenda - Ordinary Council Meeting - 25 March 2026 (5.94 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 28 January 2025

Wednesday, January 28, 2026 - 04:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 5pm unless stated otherwise. This Meeting of Council will be held at 4.30pm.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests before 12noon the day prior via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Livestream Link: https://youtube.com/live/dQi9GCk1ipc?feature=share 

Minutes

PUBLIC MINUTES - Ordinary Council Meeting - 28 January 2026 (79.91 MB)

Agenda

PUBLIC AGENDA - Ordinary Council Meeting - 28 January 2026 (79.87 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Wednesday, September 16, 2026 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council via Livestream

A Special Council Meeting was called by Mayor Browner. For further information click here.

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public may continue to participate by submitting questions relating only to items listed on the Special Council Meeting Agenda, via the required online registration forms available at:

Public question time form

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below

Agenda

Public Agenda Special Council Meeting 16 September 2026 (11.76 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. Wednesday, May 20, 2026 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council via Livestream

A Special Council Meeting was called by Mayor Browner. For further information click here.

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public may continue to participate by submitting questions relating only to items listed on the Special Council Meeting Agenda, via the required online registration forms available at:

Public question time form

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below

Public Minutes - Special Council Meeting - 20 May 2026 (353.84 KB)

Agenda

Public Agenda - Special Council Meeting - 20 May 2026 (244.37 KB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Public Agenda - Special Council Meeting - 5 February 2026 (285.97 KB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Special Council Meeting - 30 January 2026

Friday, January 30, 2026 - 12:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:   

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Livestream Link: https://youtube.com/live/Umu6s0keKNk?feature=share 

Minutes

Public Minutes - Special Council Meeting - 30 January 2025 (187.74 KB)

Agenda

Public Agenda - Special Council Meeting - 30 January 2026 (223.55 KB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Please note that meetings will commence at 5pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests before 12noon the day prior via the required online registration forms at:

PUBLIC AGENDA - Ordinary Council Meeting - 19 November 2025 (19.11 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 15 October 2025

Wednesday, October 15, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 5pm unless stated otherwise. 

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests before 12noon the day prior via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 17 September 2025

Wednesday, September 17, 2025 - 04:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 5pm unless stated otherwise. This Ordinary Council Meeting will be held at 4.30pm. 

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests before 12noon the day prior via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below.

PUBLIC AGENDA - Ordinary Council Meeting - 17 September 2025 (30.67 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 20 August 2025

Wednesday, August 20, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 7pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 22 July 2025 - POSTPONED

Tuesday, July 22, 2025 - 05:00 PM

The Ordinary Council Meeting scheduled for 22 July 2025 has been postponed until further notice.

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 7pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 25 March 2025

Tuesday, March 25, 2025 - 07:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 7pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Livestream Link: https://youtube.com/live/FYxSOc3NJ-o?feature=share

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting.

Agenda

Ordinary Council Meeting - 25 March 2025 - PUBLIC AGENDA (41.58 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Agenda

Public Agenda - Special Council Meeting - 03 Decemebr 2025 (217.03 KB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

AGENDA - Special Council Meeting - 03 June 2025 (1.25 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Friday, March 14, 2025 - 09:00 AM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

Special Council Meeting 14 March PUBLIC AGENDA (110.49 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Tuesday, December 10, 2024 - 07:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 7pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:

Ordinary Council Meeting - 22 October 2024

Tuesday, October 22, 2024 - 07:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact (08) 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 7pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Attending Council via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Please note that meetings will commence at 7pm unless stated otherwise.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 27 February 2024

Tuesday, February 27, 2024 - 07:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Officer (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Wednesday, September 4, 2024 - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

Special Council Meeting - 19 August 2024

Monday, August 19, 2024 - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. Special Council Meeting - 17 May 2024

Friday, May 17, 2024 - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings and Livestream Links below.

Tuesday, April 9, 2024 - 06:30 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Special Council Meeting via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online registration forms at:

Public question time form

Ordinary Council Meeting - 12 December 2023

Tuesday, December 12, 2023 - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting and their presentations can be made. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and address requests via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Officer (08) 9273 3500.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 26 September 2023

Tuesday, September 26, 2023 - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Officer (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 28 February 2023

Tuesday, February 28, 2023 - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings and Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting. 

Ordinary Council Meeting - Tuesday, 28 February 2023, 6pm in the Council Chamber

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Location: Council Chamber

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online registration forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 28 June 2022

Tuesday, June 28, 2022 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting.

Agenda

2022 Council Meeting Agenda - 28 June (67.79 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 26 April 2022

Tuesday, April 26, 2022 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact council@nedlands.wa.gov.au or 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting. 

Ordinary Council Meeting - 26 April 2022 - 6 pm in the Council Chamber

2022 Council Meeting Minutes - 26 April (32.80 MB)

2022 Council Meeting Minutes - 26 April (word version) (2.90 MB)

Agenda

2022 Council Meeting Agenda - 26 April (word version) (2.81 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Contact Us

Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm.

  • 71 Stirling Hwy Nedlands WA 6009
  • PO Box 9 Nedlands WA 6909
  • P: 08 9273 3500
  • ABN: 92 614 728 214

Ordinary Council Meeting - 22 February 2022

Tuesday, February 22, 2022 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting. 

Minutes

2022 Council Meeting Minutes - 22 February (96.19 MB)

2022 Council Meeting Minutes - 22 February - word version (5.85 MB)

Agenda

2022 Council Meeting Agenda - 22 February (102.94 MB)

2022 Council Meeting Agenda - 22 February - word version (5.73 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Contact Us

Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm.

  • 71 Stirling Hwy Nedlands WA 6009

  • P: 08 9273 3500

Special Council Meeting - 27 June 2022

Monday, June 27, 2022 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Special Council Meeting - 17 May 2022

Tuesday, May 17, 2022 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Special Council Meeting - 29 March 2022

Tuesday, March 29, 2022 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting. 

Minutes

2022 Special Council Meeting Minutes - 29 March - word version (2.63 MB)

2022 Special Council Meeting Minutes - 29 March (51.26 MB)

Agenda

2022 Special Council Meeting Agenda - 29 March - word version (2.65 MB)

2022 Special Council Meeting Agenda - 29 March (51.39 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Contact Us

Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm.

Special Council Meeting - 18 January 2022

Tuesday, January 18, 2022 - 06:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Upcoming Meetings & Livestream Links below. 

Please note: These links will be updated for each meeting. 

Minutes

Special Council Meeting Minutes - 18 January 2022 (540.22 MB)

Agenda

Special Council Meeting Agenda - 18 January 2022 (540.22 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 14 December 2021

Tuesday, December 14, 2021 - 07:00 PM

Attending Council or Council Meeting Agenda Forums via Livestream

All Council meetings will also be online, accessible to the public via livestream.

Members of the public wishing to ask questions or make presentations will be assisted by a City officer to ensure their presentations and questions are read by the Presiding Member at the meeting. Contact 9273 3500 for more information. 

Please note that meetings will commence at 6pm unless stated otherwise.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and addresses via the required online submission forms at:   

Intention to address form

Public question time form

For further assistance please contact the Executive Assistant (08) 9273 3500.

Special Council Meeting - 02 February 2021

Tuesday, February 2, 2021 - 07:00 PM

Minutes

Special Council Meeting - 02 February 2021 - Minutes (58.17 MB)

Special Council Meeting - 02 February 2021 - Minutes (1.32 MB)

Agenda

Special Council Meeting - 02 February 2021 - Agenda (57.31 MB)

Special Council Meeting - 02 February 2021 - Agenda (1.26 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Contact Us

Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm.

  • 71 Stirling Hwy Nedlands WA 6009
  • PO Box 9 Nedlands WA 6909
  • P: 08 9273 3500

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Special Council Meeting - 19 November 2020

Thursday, November 19, 2020 - 07:00 PM

Minutes

Special Council Meeting Minutes - 19 November2020 - Redacted (36.96 MB)

Special Council Meeting Agenda - 19 November 2020 - Redacted (36.90 MB)

Attachments

Special Council Meeting - 19 November 2020 - SCM RAR & Attachments - 5 Hillway Nedlands (26.99 MB)

Special Council Meeting - 19 November 2020 - SCM RAR & Attachments - 13 Vincent Street Nedlands (16.37 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Tuesday, September 29, 2020 - 05:00 PM

Agenda

Special Council Meeting - 29 September 2020 - Agenda (2.24 MB)

Special Council Meeting - 29 September 2020 - Agenda (27.86 MB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Agenda

Special Council Meeting - 10 September 2020 - Agenda (119.05 KB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Special Council Meeting - 07 July 2020

Tuesday, July 7, 2020 - 07:00 PM

Minutes

Special Council Meeting - 07 July 2020 - Minutes (133.25 KB)

Special Council Meeting - 07 July 2020 - Minutes (232.87 KB)

Agenda

Special Council Meeting - 07 July 2020 - Agenda (122.98 KB)

Special Council Meeting - 07 July 2020 - Agenda (166.31 KB)

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm.

The City of Nedlands acknowledges the traditional custodians of this land, the Whadjuk people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to culture and Elders, past and present. The City of Nedlands also values the contributions made to the community over the years by people of diverse backgrounds and cultures, including those who have served and sacrificed.

Council Meetings

Subscribe to Council Meetings

Items requiring a Council Decision go through the following process:

  1. Council reports first go to a Council Meeting Agenda Forum. (Please note no decisions are made at these Forums)
  2. Council then makes decisions on the reports at a Council Meeting.

Council Meeting Agenda Forums 

The City of Nedlands Council Meeting Agenda Forums are governed by the City of Nedlands Governance Framework Policy adopted by Council at its Ordinary Meeting on 14 December 2021.

A copy of the Governance Framework Policy is available on the City's website via the link below or can be provided upon request.

Governance Framework Policy

The above meetings are open to the public, however, once the venue is at capacity, no further admission into the room will be permitted.

Community Members can also attend these meetings via livestream.

The public can continue to participate by submitting questions and/or registering to address the Council via the required online forms at:   

Intention to Address the Council Meeting, Council Meeting Agenda Forum or Committee Meeting Form
Public Question Time

For further assistance please contact the Administration (08) 9273 3500.

    Electors Meetings

    Annual General Meeting

    Councils are required to have a general meeting of electors (Annual General Meeting) once every year. The date and time will be chosen by the City and advertised to the public well in advance.

    Special Electors Meetings

    Special meetings of electors can be requested by:

    • 100 electors of the City or 5% of total electors, whichever is the lesser; or
    • One-third of the Elected Members

    Any request to hold a special meeting of electors must specify the matters to be discussed at the meeting (the form and content of the request is to be in accordance with regulations and be submitted to the Mayor

    The Mayor will then select the day of the meeting. According to legislation, this must not be more than 35 days after receipt of the request.

    Further information regarding electors meetings can be obtained from Sections 5.26 to 5.35 of the Local Government Act 1995.
